comment: shk.c unpaid_cost() report from floor and pickup messages. Seed 8452217's Dlvl 4 has a weapon shop whose keeper stands at (54,5) inside an open door at (53,5); a debug-mode Samurai who level-teleports there lands at (58,3) on 10 darts (port-only scanSeeds() probe over 8452000-8452400 for a hero who lands on an object inside a shop with its keeper at home: 16 hits, this one chosen for its weapon shop). He picks up the darts (unpaid), hurls the keeper west through the door with #wiztelekinesis (wizcmds.c wiz_telekinesis() -> mhurtle()), wishes for a hole under himself (objnam.c wizterrainwish()) and plunges through it with '>'. shk.c u_left_shop() returns early because the keeper is not inhishop(), so the darts stay unpaid on Dlvl 5, where no bill holds them: every objnam.c doname() of them reaches shk.c unpaid_cost(), which reports "unpaid_cost: object wasn't on any bill." through impossible() (3302-3303), and C prints that report while it formats the name, before the window or message that uses it. He drops the darts with 'd' (do.c dodrop(): report, then "You drop %s."), looks at them with ':' (invent.c look_here() 4282: report, then "You see here %s." through doname_with_price()), and picks them up again with ',' (pickup.c pickup_prinv() -> invent.c prinv(): report, then the inventory line). Seed, datetime, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session and batch game.
